# Experiment policy — example company handbook
The golden evaluation set is held out from prompt tuning. Development queries guide revisions. Run each query three times to estimate sampling spread. Log prompt version, retrieval top_k, temperature, tokens, latency, and the full raw tool trajectory. Calibration labels are manually reviewed rather than generated by the assistant.

# Legacy release memo — superseded
This document is historical. The old 2024 process promoted any model when accuracy exceeded 0.80. It is superseded by release-policy: current releases use F1 and ROC-AUC on a frozen holdout. Do not apply the old rule.

# Release policy — example company handbook
Production model changes require an evaluation on a frozen holdout. Promote only when F1 improves by at least 0.005 and ROC-AUC drops by no more than 0.01. A drift alert alone never authorizes promotion. Keep the previous production version for rollback. The release approver is the project owner.
